facts.business: GE Vernova T&D India Limited is a leading electrical infrastructure and power sector player offering comprehensive grid technologies including power transformers, GIS, circuit breakers, instrument transformers, grid automation, digital solutions, HVDC, and FACTS compensation systems for power generation, transmission, and distribution sectors.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capex investments in sustainability and workplace improvements
R&D investments in environmentally and socially responsible innovations

guidance_or_targets.statement: India's transmission sector requires 50,000 ckm of high-voltage transmission lines and 125 GVA of transformation capacity annually through 2032, representing an investment opportunity exceeding ₹9 trillion
Additional requirement for over 60 GW of new HVDC corridors through FY2032–36

facts.related_party_note: Inter corporate deposit to related party (LM Wind Power Blades (India) Pvt Ltd) of ₹9,710.4 million as at 31 March 2026, bearing interest 5.49% to 6.47% p.a., secured by guarantee from ultimate Parent Company GE Vernova Inc. up to INR 10,000 million
